context: Evaluates correct usage of the Vendure package's update-item mutation hook, including passing a LineItem as the item context to the hook, calling the returned function with a new quantity, and handling ValidationError when required IDs are missing.

checklist.name: Import useUpdateItem
checklist.description: The solution imports `useUpdateItem` from `@vercel/commerce-vendure` and invokes it as a hook with an optional `{ item }` context object.

checklist.name: Pass item context
checklist.description: The hook is called with `{ item: lineItem }` where lineItem has `id`, `productId`, and `variantId`, enabling the returned function to resolve IDs automatically.

checklist.name: ValidationError on missing IDs
checklist.description: The solution demonstrates that calling the update function when itemId, productId, or variantId cannot be resolved throws a `ValidationError` from the package.

checklist.name: Cart mutate after success
checklist.description: After a successful quantity update, the cart data is refreshed (mutate is called under the hood), so the updated quantity is reflected in the cart state.
